summary: The editor-role case timed out because it made 11 navigations under Playwright's 30s budget (17-28s in #256-#261, 31-34s in #262); it is now 12 tests, one per domain like the reader-role describe, with the same 43 assertions (ElectronicsInventory 0eb150ab on phase/036-P14). The full suite passes in a development-namespace Job on the library's validation-Job manifest (backend 1137/0, frontend 256/0, no retries) and the frontend lint is green; the named gate `kc project test` cannot run in this environment, which has no s3storage/postgres service (close-out E7).
